The following events took place in '''96 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

This [[Standard year/Legends|year]] was known as '''Year 61''' before the [[Great ReSynchronization]].

==Events==
*[[Sister (Witches of Dathomir)|Sister]] [[Charal]], a [[Witches of Dathomir|Witch of Dathomir]] who abandoned her coven, allies with [[Terak]], [[King/Legends|king]] of the [[Sanyassan Marauders/Legends|Sanyassan Marauders]]. The witch and the Marauders are stranded on [[Endor/Legends|the forest moon of Endor]]. Charal proclaims herself [[Witch-Queen]] of Endor.<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
*The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Danoor]], located in the [[Nah'Malis system]] of the [[Kathol Outback/Legends|Kathol Outback]], is colonized by [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] studying in the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]].<ref name="TKO">''[[The Kathol Outback]]''</ref>
*The [[Shreeftut]] of [[Lwhekk/Legends|Lwhekk]] assumes power over the [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium]] after years of political infighting between his allies and the former ruler's supporters. {{Circa}}<ref name="TTABS" />
